residual_risks: Public-profile crew tabs can still fall back to `/crews/:id/profile` `recentPosts` previews when the viewer cannot read the full member-only crew posts feed, so feed depth may differ by permission.
FeedCard/PostFeedCard reuse now matches the target surface more closely, but there is still no dedicated automated coverage around `fetchCrewPostsFromCrews()` and its permission-based fallback path.
Own-profile workouts now receive the real runner identity again, but feed-only metadata still depends on what the `/workouts?userId=` contract returns.
